# go-freedesktop

Pure-Go (`CGO_ENABLED=0`, BSD-3-Clause) implementations of freedesktop.org
specifications.

## Repositories

- **[icontheme](https://github.com/go-freedesktop/icontheme)** — the
  [Icon Theme Specification](https://specifications.freedesktop.org/icon-theme/latest/)
  lookup: resolve an icon name (e.g. a `.desktop` `Icon=` value) to a file path
  at a target size and scale, following theme inheritance and the hicolor
  fallback. 100%-tested, multi-arch CI.

_Note: this profile is a draft; the org-level `.github` repository, landing page,
and MkDocs site are a follow-up._
